answer_1.quote: We propose a method based on textual-entailment and supervised only with NLI and sentence-level Semantics Role Labeling (SRL) data. It takes a document and a marked predicate and outputs a set of simple, easy-to-grasp sentences that incorporate semantic arguments from anywhere in the document
answer_1.outputs: simple, easy-to-grasp sentences that incorporate semantic arguments from anywhere in the document

answer_2.quote: We calculate the standard precision and recall metrics over entities, summing entity counts over all instances in the dataset.

answer_3.quote: We also apply our method with the Mistral LLM serving as the underlying entailment engine. ... To get a normalized probability of entailment given the premise-hypothesis pair, we apply the softmax function over the corresponding logit values of "Yes" and "No" from the first decoded vector of logits and select the probability of "Yes".
